I farm this land the way I know best: steadily, without taking big risks, and with the work arranged so my family can manage it. I have 14 mu with well irrigation, and my usual system is winter wheat followed by summer maize, so I will keep the full 14 mu in that rotation. I am 68, so I will choose methods that are reliable and not too labor-heavy. For wheat, I will use improved seed, put enough fertilizer to keep the stand strong, irrigate at the key times, and keep field management simple and timely. For summer maize, I will also plant the full 14 mu right after wheat harvest, use hybrid seed for stable production, reduce unnecessary tillage, and rely on a few key waterings and basic pest control. I will not chase the highest possible yield; I will aim for a steady harvest that matches my land, water, and labor.
